## Recent work:
Optimized `invoice_summary` by moving invoice filtering outside the currency loop, aggregating once per account, and batching minor-unit conversion. Query count fell from 2,417 to 37; tenant 73 runtime fell from 38.6 seconds to 4.27 seconds, and `build_summary` cumulative profile time from 39.1 to 4.46 seconds. Added a 37-query regression assertion. Validation passed: 18 invoice-summary tests, 63 report tests with 2 PostgreSQL skips, Ruff, and `git diff --check`.

Work then shifted to invoice PDF rendering, but no renderer changes have been made. Baseline: `12 passed, 1 skipped`; `render_invoice()` delegates to `_format_lines()` and uses a two-page canvas.
